_doc: MISUMI HFS8-4040: a 40 x 40 mm aluminium extrusion of its 8 series, clear anodised (HFSB8-4040 is the same section in black). Dimensions, area, second moments and mass are from MISUMI's catalogue page. The drawn outline leaves out the four small lobes round the bore, the step inside each corner block and the hollows' rounded corners. MISUMI prints no section modulus or torsion constant.

twist_per_metre.rule: Twist: 1/2 degree or less in any 300 mm for a circumscribed circle over 38 to 76 mm (56.6 mm here), at most 5 degrees over the whole length. JIS special grade, as MISUMI's tolerance page gives it
